knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to notify the nominated contact early with factual information and a proposed next step, and to avoid exaggerated promises.
The lesson says to report factually, avoid blame and arguments, and use the nominated contact.
The instruction says to wear clean appropriate clothing, enclosed non-slip footwear and task-specific PPE.

practicalCriteria: Checks the site/task requirements before acting
Identifies and applies relevant safety and privacy controls
Communicates professionally and respects authorisation boundaries
Records the outcome and escalates unresolved issues correctly
passRule: All safety-critical criteria must be demonstrated; remediate and reassess any missed criterion.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation record covering procedure steps 1-8
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 5 is not done: Speak clearly and respectfully, listen to the client's priorities, and do not discuss other customers.
